description:
Activate Soul of Windgrace's second ability by paying {R} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace ability, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
